# How many child visits a week does your indoor play centre need to break even, and how much cash does the ramp-up eat?

> Free indoor play center profit calculator: weekday and weekend visits, memberships, birthday parties, cafe spend, staffing, rent and a loan become monthly profit, break-even visits a week, the price change that hits a target margin, the ramp-up cash reserve and payback. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
